## Investigation contract, 2026-09-07

Evidence and corrections:
Report: /Users/mz/Documents/my-vault/LLMs/investigations/ancora/2026-09-07-agent-adoption-friction/04-report.md
Measurements: /Users/mz/Documents/my-vault/LLMs/investigations/ancora/2026-09-07-agent-adoption-friction/03-measurements.md
Source revision: 82c2ca8329e1303ececc610dfc9f72986b96c84a. This contract proposes work; no implementation is claimed.

Deliverable:
Use Gate's resolved HEAD findings as the single source for review's current-state severities and counts. Resolve base repository findings using base config from the same selected workspace. Do not apply a HEAD branch trailer to the base snapshot; retain its effect on HEAD as policy provenance. Compare finding identity independently of severity so a downgrade/off policy change is not represented as a repaired defect. Show policy changes separately, preserving suppressed counts according to existing off/info rules, and keep the artifact's verdict aligned with Gate. Preserve acknowledgment reasons and severity_source.

Verification:
- The saved duplicate-covers example must show zero errors and one info in both Gate and the matching review current-state counts.
- Render fixtures with default, configured info, off, requirement override, trailer downgrade and subject acknowledgment. Compare check JSON to the review view model and rendered chip/panel counts for the same run.
- A policy-only downgrade is identified as policy change, not defect repair; an actual removed finding remains resolved. Base and HEAD config differences remain visible. No second raw HEAD severity path remains.
- Cadence: focused tests during implementation; at final verification run mix compile --warnings-as-errors, mix test, mix format --check-formatted, mix deps.unlock --check-unused and mix spec.check against the actual integration base. CI must pass both configured Elixir/OTP combinations. Record evidence of the described symptom after the consuming release before claiming it done.

Allowed touches:
lib/ancora/review.ex, lib/ancora/review/findings_delta.ex, review view model/renderers and assets, necessary Gate policy data plumbing, relevant tests and ancora.review/findings specs.

Out of Scope (files):
Unrelated production modules, credentials, dependencies and consumer repositories. Release metadata belongs to release preparation.

Out of Scope (intent):
No review redesign, change to gate severity precedence, or new acknowledgment semantics.

Merge gate:
- [ ] Focused negative and positive behavior fixtures pass.
- [ ] Affected specs and decisions describe the actual changed behavior.
- [ ] Full repository CI and spec gate pass without cosmetic acknowledgment edits.

Decision:
Use one resolved HEAD result. The actual overlap probe produces Gate info versus review error, so a CSS or chip-only repair cannot resolve the mismatch.

Open Questions:
None. Unmeasured consumer replay and release behavior are explicit Verification obligations, not claimed results.
